title: {{name}}'s journal
subtitle: Dated notes on how you live your Strategy and your Authority. They stay on your device only.

reminder.title: Your starting point
reminder.note: This is your own experiment: there is no right result to reach.

form.textPlaceholder: Write down a situation, how you decided and how you felt afterwards…
form.outcome: How did it go with your Strategy and Authority?
form.promptsHint: Tap a prompt to insert it into the note.

prompts.choice: What situation put a choice in front of me, and how did I respond?
prompts.body: What did I feel in my body before deciding?
prompts.wait: What difference did I see when I gave myself time, or when I didn't?

errors.textTooLong: The note is too long (maximum {{max}} characters).
errors.dateFuture: The day cannot be in the future.

empty.title: The journal is empty
empty.description: Write the first note: a few lines are enough. Over time you will see how your way of deciding changes.

delete.title: Delete this note?
delete.description: The note of {{date}} will be removed from this device.

toast.saveError: The note could not be saved. Try again.
toast.deleteError: The note could not be deleted.
